dynamicProperties.description: JDBC driver property name and value applied to JDBC connections.
dynamicProperties.name: JDBC property name

dynamicProperties.description: JDBC driver property name prefixed with 'SENSITIVE.' handled as a sensitive property.
dynamicProperties.name: SENSITIVE.JDBC property name

Database Connection URL.description: A database connection URL used to connect to a database. May contain database system name, host, port, database name and some parameters. The exact syntax of a database connection URL is specified by your DBMS.
Database Connection URL.expressionLanguageScopeDescription: Environment variables defined at JVM level and system properties
Database Connection URL.name: Database Connection URL

Database Driver Class Name.expressionLanguageScopeDescription: Environment variables defined at JVM level and system properties
Database Driver Class Name.name: Database Driver Class Name

Database Driver Locations.description: Comma-separated list of files/folders and/or URLs containing the driver JAR and its dependencies (if any). For example '/var/tmp/mariadb-java-client-1.1.7.jar'
Database Driver Locations.expressionLanguageScopeDescription: Environment variables defined at JVM level and system properties
Database Driver Locations.name: Database Driver Locations

Database Password Provider.description: Controller Service that supplies database passwords on demand. When configured, the Password property is ignored.
Database Password Provider.name: Database Password Provider

Database User.expressionLanguageScopeDescription: Environment variables defined at JVM level and system properties
Database User.name: Database User

Kerberos User Service.description: Specifies the Kerberos User Controller Service that should be used for authenticating with Kerberos
Kerberos User Service.name: Kerberos User Service

Max Total Connections.description: The maximum number of active connections that can be allocated from this pool at the same time,  or negative for no limit.
Max Total Connections.expressionLanguageScopeDescription: Environment variables defined at JVM level and system properties
Max Total Connections.name: Max Total Connections

Max Wait Time.description: The maximum amount of time that the pool will wait (when there are no available connections)  for a connection to be returned before failing, or -1 to wait indefinitely.
Max Wait Time.expressionLanguageScopeDescription: Environment variables defined at JVM level and system properties
Max Wait Time.name: Max Wait Time

Maximum Connection Lifetime.description: The maximum lifetime of a connection. After this time is exceeded the connection will fail the next activation, passivation or validation test. A value of zero or less means the connection has an infinite lifetime.
Maximum Connection Lifetime.expressionLanguageScopeDescription: Environment variables defined at JVM level and system properties
Maximum Connection Lifetime.name: Maximum Connection Lifetime

Maximum Idle Connections.description: The maximum number of connections that can remain idle in the pool without extra ones being released. Set to any negative value to allow unlimited idle connections.
Maximum Idle Connections.expressionLanguageScopeDescription: Environment variables defined at JVM level and system properties
Maximum Idle Connections.name: Maximum Idle Connections

Minimum Evictable Idle Time.description: The minimum amount of time a connection may sit idle in the pool before it is eligible for eviction.
Minimum Evictable Idle Time.expressionLanguageScopeDescription: Environment variables defined at JVM level and system properties
Minimum Evictable Idle Time.name: Minimum Evictable Idle Time

Minimum Idle Connections.description: The minimum number of connections that can remain idle in the pool without extra ones being created. Set to or zero to allow no idle connections.
Minimum Idle Connections.expressionLanguageScopeDescription: Environment variables defined at JVM level and system properties
Minimum Idle Connections.name: Minimum Idle Connections

Password.description: The password for the database user
Password.expressionLanguageScopeDescription: Environment variables defined at JVM level and system properties
Password.name: Password

allowableValues.description: Use the configured Password property for database authentication.
Obtain database passwords from a configured Database Password Provider.

Password Source.description: Specifies whether to supply the database password directly or obtain it from a Database Password Provider.
Password Source.name: Password Source

Soft Minimum Evictable Idle Time.description: The minimum amount of time a connection may sit idle in the pool before it is eligible for eviction by the idle connection evictor, with the extra condition that at least a minimum number of idle connections remain in the pool. When the not-soft version of this option is set to a positive value, it is examined first by the idle connection evictor: when idle connections are visited by the evictor, idle time is first compared against it (without considering the number of idle connections in the pool) and then against this soft option, including the minimum idle connections constraint.
Soft Minimum Evictable Idle Time.expressionLanguageScopeDescription: Environment variables defined at JVM level and system properties
Soft Minimum Evictable Idle Time.name: Soft Minimum Evictable Idle Time

Time Between Eviction Runs.description: The time period to sleep between runs of the idle connection evictor thread. When non-positive, no idle connection evictor thread will be run.
Time Between Eviction Runs.expressionLanguageScopeDescription: Environment variables defined at JVM level and system properties
Time Between Eviction Runs.name: Time Between Eviction Runs

Validation Query.description: Validation query used to validate connections before returning them. When connection is invalid, it gets dropped and new valid connection will be returned. Note!! Using validation might have some performance penalty.
Validation Query.expressionLanguageScopeDescription: Environment variables defined at JVM level and system properties
Validation Query.name: Validation Query

typeDescription: Provides Database Connection Pooling Service. Connections can be asked from pool and returned after usage.
